blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–NLEX’s Deonte Burton and San Miguel Beer’s George King emerged as the early contenders for the PBA Governors’ Cup Best Import award through the end of the group. Burton tallied 55.0 Statistical Points to lead the derby with King in second after posting 53.1 based on the official tally released by the PBA on Monday. READ: PBA: Burton sees different side of Alapag after NLEX’s slow start Meralco’s Jordon Varnado is third with 52.7 followed by Converge’s Cameron Clark (48.8), Blackwater’s Kentrell Barkley (47.6) and Barangay Ginebra’s Jordan Murphy (47.0).
